claims.text:
16. dbscan-density

Target / packet: ai-dbscan-density · C1. Prerequisites: ai:k-means-clustering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: k-means-clustering → bad-start-kmeans. K-means requests a number of groups; DBSCAN requests local density and may mark a point noise or return no clusters.

Finite primary model: 1D points [0,.1,.2,1,1.1,1.2,5], eps=.15, min_samples 2 includes self; all first 6 core, giving two clusters and noise 5. eps=.05 makes all points noise.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: eps 1 permits the first 6 to connect into one cluster; point 5 remains noise. Use inclusive distance<=eps and floating-point tolerance; minimum density is not a requested number of groups.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which point is noise at .15; recall what changes when eps becomes .05.

Required observable evidence: Show epsilon neighborhoods and component membership; no random data generation or label chosen by desired cluster count.

Source obligation: [scikit-learn clustering documentation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/clustering.html), acquired method body §§2.3.2 k-means,2.3.6 hierarchical methods,2.3.7 DBSCAN. Each local convention and actual result is independently derivable; do not infer true populations from requested groups.
 Shipped local model and displayed expression addresses: model.ts compute; Demo.tsx Figure; Stage retained computed witnesses.
